fix(ci): simplify psdk js release runtime

Summary:
- switch the JS release workflow to setup-node v6 with Node 25
- remove the separate npm CLI upgrade step from release-js

Rationale:
- Node 25 already provides npm 11.x, so the extra upgrade is redundant
- local Node 25 validation passed publish dry-run and package build checks

Tests:
- node release workflow audit script
- cd js && npm_config_dry_run=true npx lerna@9.0.1 publish from-package --yes --no-verify-access
- cd js && npx -y yarn@1 install --ignore-scripts --non-interactive
- cd js && npx -y yarn@1 build:all
- cd js && npx -y yarn@1 package:all
- git diff --check
